patch_description:
This crossover version keeps the stronger short-horizon and regime-aware ideas from the better prior programs, while reducing dependence on long lookbacks that appeared to overfit the earlier regime.

Key changes:
- Uses shorter rolling windows more heavily (5/10/20/40) to improve regime adaptability.
- Adds rolling z-scored returns and z-scored volume to normalize across changing volatility environments.
- Adds explicit “market character change” features: volatility trend, efficiency trend, autocorrelation trend, and regime-change deltas.
- Keeps a compact feature count under the 80-feature limit while preserving the most useful price, volatility, momentum, range, volume, and interaction signals.
- Uses a slightly less constrained XGBoost setup than the collapsing version, but still regularized enough to avoid extreme overfit.

The interface, inputs, outputs, and run_experiment logic remain unchanged.
